name: Aligned Data Centers
legalName: Aligned Data Centers, LLC (launched as Aligned Energy)
founded: 2013 (as Aligned Energy, out of founder Jakob Carnemark's Inertech/Karbon cooling ventures; first data center opened in Plano, TX in 2016; Andrew Schaap named CEO in 2017)
ownership: private (investor-owned — 100% of equity acquired by the AIP/MGX/BlackRock GIP consortium, closed July 2026)
summary: BOTTOM LINE UP FRONT: Aligned Data Centers is the subject of the largest data-center M&A transaction on record — on 21 July 2026 the Artificial Intelligence Infrastructure Partnership (AIP), MGX, and BlackRock's Global Infrastructure Partners (GIP) closed their acquisition of 100% of the equity from funds managed by Macquarie Asset Management and co-invest partners at an enterprise value of approximately $40B, with a further $5B of growth capital committed at closing; the deal — AIP's first-ever investment against its $30B equity / up-to-$100B-with-debt mandate — hands a platform of 51 campuses and 6.4 GW of operational and planned capacity across the US, Brazil, Mexico, Chile and Colombia to a consortium whose backers include Microsoft, NVIDIA, xAI, Cisco, GE Vernova, NextEra, Kuwait Investment Authority and Temasek. BACKGROUND: Dallas-based build-to-scale operator-landlord, founded 2013 as Aligned Energy; CEO Andrew Schaap (ex-Digital Realty) since 2017, retained post-close along with the Dallas HQ. Macquarie's MIP IV entered in April 2018 at 85 MW across two facilities (Dallas, Phoenix); the exit platform spans ten-plus US markets and four Latin American countries (via the ODATA acquisition, closed May 2023, reported ~$1.8B including debt). The differentiation is proprietary waterless cooling — the patented Delta³ (Delta Cube) air-cooled array (up to 50 kW/rack, 50+ patents) and patent-pending DeltaFlow universal liquid cooling (350 kW/rack heat rejection; 600+ kW/rack hybrid) — wrapped in an adaptive design that scales customers from empty slab to megawatts in the same hall. The gigascale phase is underway: the 540 MW Project Caprock campus in Hale County, TX broke ground April 2026 with first delivery targeted Q1 2027, and the capital machine re-opened post-close with a $1.183B securitization within a week of the acquisition closing (all per company releases, Macquarie sale materials, and trade press).
ecosystemRole: We assess Aligned as the marquee private wholesale developer-landlord in this ecosystem — the asset the AI-capital complex chose as its first purchase: AIP's strategic members (Microsoft, NVIDIA, xAI) and sovereign anchors now own the landlord, a structural signal that hyperscale demand intends to secure its own capacity pipeline. For power-chain, cooling, and construction vendors Aligned is a standardized, cooling-led procurement machine: Delta³ arrays are company-designed (manufactured in Brazil for LatAm), campuses replicate a common adaptive-density design across ten-plus US markets, and the post-close war chest ($5B committed growth capital, a $2.58B development credit facility, a re-opened ABS program) funds a multi-GW buildout. Basis: company releases, Macquarie sale materials, and trade press; we note Aligned publishes no revenue or backlog figures, so scale must be read from capacity and financing disclosures.

productsAndServices.name: Build-to-Scale hyperscale campuses (the wholesale core)
productsAndServices.description: Dedicated buildings and data halls delivered on the customer's expansion schedule under Aligned's 'Build-to-Scale' model — powered shell through fully fit-out turnkey — across ten-plus US markets: Dallas-Fort Worth (Plano DFW-01/-02/-04, Mansfield), Phoenix (including two announced mega-campuses), Salt Lake City metro (West Jordan SLC-01 through SLC-04), Northern Virginia (Ashburn and Sterling), Chicago metro, Northeast Ohio (three campuses including the 197-acre Coshocton County mega-scale AI site on the former AEP Conesville plant), Hillsboro OR, Atlanta (ATL-01, Suwanee GA), and Maryland (Quantum Loophole Frederick agreement). ExpandOnDemand lets a tenant densify or extend within the same hall without a new build.
highlights: 51 campuses / 6.4 GW operational and planned at the July 2026 close, per the consortium's announcement
Platform grew from 85 MW / 2 facilities at Macquarie's April 2018 entry to 5+ GW / 50 campuses at the October 2025 sale announcement, per Macquarie
First OCP-Ready for Hyperscale certified operator (company announcement); customer NPS consistently above 90 per company
Strategic minority investment in QScale (Lévis, Québec — May 2023) extends reach toward Canada without an owned campus
productsAndServices.positioning: Sits in the private wholesale cohort against Vantage, QTS (Blackstone), STACK, Switch, and CyrusOne; differentiates on adaptive density (air-to-liquid transition inside a live hall, 'slab to megawatts') and waterless cooling rather than on land-bank scale alone. Distinct from retail-interconnection platforms (Equinix): Aligned sells capacity and speed, not network density.
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Direct wholesale leases with hyperscalers, neoclouds, and large enterprises — powered shell, dedicated data halls, or turnkey; managed services (remote hands, custom fit-out) attach at the edges.
targetSegments: Neoclouds — Lambda publicly named at DFW-04 Plano (May 2025)
Large enterprise and federal (Aligned Federal unit)
productsAndServices.roadmap: SLC-03 adds 100+ MW in West Jordan (announced for 2026); Coshocton County OH first building targeted mid-2026; Phoenix mega-campuses phased; Frederick MD campus per the Quantum Loophole agreement.

productsAndServices.name: Gigascale AI campuses / powered land (Project Caprock)
productsAndServices.description: End-to-end 'power-first' development of gigawatt-class AI campuses: strategic land acquisition with early power enablement, dedicated utility infrastructure funded by Aligned, and DeltaFlow liquid cooling as the design baseline. Flagship: Project Caprock, Hale County (Abernathy), Northwest Texas — 540 MW, 313 acres, ~1.65M sq ft across six facilities on Xcel Energy infrastructure built and funded by Aligned; groundbreaking April 2026, first facility (LBB-01) targeted for Q1 2027 service.
highlights: Company-estimated ~$5B regional economic infusion at Caprock; thousands of construction jobs

Energy strategy pairs campuses with storage: 31 MW / 62 MWh Calibrant BESS at the Pacific Northwest campus (operational 2026) — company-described first US battery system purpose-built to accelerate data-center interconnection
Public commitment to Texas Gov. Abbott's data-center standards (grid funding, zero-water cooling, community engagement) amid the August 2026 ERCOT interconnection audit
productsAndServices.positioning: Answers the powered-land competition (Vantage/STACK gigascale sites, Applied Digital-style AI factories) with utility-partnered greenfields in low-competition West Texas rather than saturated Virginia/Dallas cores; the BESS-for-interconnection play targets the industry's binding constraint — queue time.
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Wholesale pre-leasing of phased buildings; dedicated utility agreements (Xcel at Caprock) funded by Aligned.
targetSegments: AI training / GPU-dense deployments needing hundreds of MW with committed delivery dates
productsAndServices.roadmap: Caprock LBB-01 Q1 2027, multi-year build-out of six facilities; Calibrant BESS operational 2026.

productsAndServices.name: Cooling technology platform — Delta³ and DeltaFlow (the differentiator)
productsAndServices.description: Proprietary, company-designed cooling deployed platform-wide rather than sold as merchant product. Delta³ (Delta Cube): patented air-cooled arrays that capture heat at the source instead of flooding halls with cold air — up to 50 kW/rack, closed-loop and waterless, one moving part, ~1% of IT load consumed by fans vs ~10% for typical CRAC/CRAH rows (company figures). DeltaFlow: patent-pending universal liquid-cooling platform — 350 kW/rack heat rejection, supporting direct-to-chip cold plates, rack CDUs, rear-door heat exchangers, and immersion pods off one technology-water spine; hybrid Delta³+DeltaFlow halls reach 600+ kW/rack combined rejection with zero-downtime transition in live environments. The Adaptive Modular Infrastructure (AMI) design and the Phoenix Advanced Cooling Lab (opened June 2025) validate next-gen GPU thermals before deployment.
highlights: 50+ issued patents and 500+ patent claims on the cooling portfolio, per company
Delta³ claims up to 80% less energy and 85% less water than conventional systems
Delta Cube manufactured in Brazil for the LatAm platform (ODATA announcement)
DeltaFlow launched January 2024 supporting 3 to 300+ kW/rack in one platform
productsAndServices.positioning: In-house cooling IP is the moat claim vs peers who buy merchant CRAH/CDU equipment (Vertiv, Stulz, Munters supply the rest of the market); the waterless closed loop removes the water-permitting veto that constrains evaporative-cooled competitors in Texas, Arizona, and Utah.
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Internal deployment across all Aligned/ODATA campuses; not sold merchant.
targetSegments: All platform tenants; positioned specifically at GPU/AI accelerator densities
productsAndServices.roadmap: Advanced Cooling Lab roadmap targets next-generation GPU rack architectures (company statements); hybrid retrofits continue across existing halls.

productsAndServices.name: Multi-tenant enterprise colocation & managed services
productsAndServices.description: The retail-ish edge of the platform: multi-tenant 'Scale' data centers, dedicated data halls, and turnkey white space for enterprises, plus managed services — 24/7 remote hands, turnkey custom fit-out, dedicated space build-out — and a separate Aligned Federal entity for US government agencies. Early-era anchor logos (Sabre, Sharp HealthCare, Datto, DHISCO, Insight) date from the 2016–2018 Plano/Phoenix vintage; the mix has shifted decisively wholesale since.
highlights: White-glove positioning ('unreasonable hospitality') with NPS above 90, per company
Federal segment addressed through a dedicated entity rather than the commercial platform
productsAndServices.positioning: A demand on-ramp and diversification layer, not the growth engine — enterprise colo keeps halls fungible between retail and wholesale as AI demand concentrates.
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Direct enterprise colocation contracts; channel/partner referral program (partner lead-registration and referral-rewards programs on the company site).
targetSegments: US federal agencies via Aligned Federal
productsAndServices.roadmap: No standalone expansion announced; grows inside new campuses.

productsAndServices.name: ODATA — the Latin America platform
productsAndServices.description: Acquired from Patria Investments (announced December 2022, closed May 2023, reported ~$1.8B including debt per Bloomberg); operates as ODATA under CEO Ricardo Alário with campuses in Brazil (São Paulo region and Northeast), Mexico (Querétaro), Chile (Santiago), and Colombia (Bogotá). Querétaro's QR03 is Mexico's largest data-center campus — 300 MW IT across five buildings and ~3M sq ft, a $3.3B investment — with 200 MW energized in February 2025 via the Ammper substation partnership; QR04 (24 MW, first 12 MW live August 2025) completed a four-facility interconnected Mexico network. Colombia: $1.3B expansion announced October 2024 (BG02 24 MW + BG03 120 MW, the country's largest).
highlights: Makes Aligned one of the largest private data-center operators across the Americas — the differentiator vs US-only wholesale peers
Renewable sourcing via LatAm PPAs: Serena Energia (Bahia wind, expanded +135%), Casa dos Ventos, Atlas Renewable Energy
Delta Cube arrays introduced to LatAm, manufactured in Brazil
productsAndServices.positioning: Positions Aligned against Ascenty (Digital Realty), Scala Data Centers, and Equinix in LatAm hyperscale; solving Querétaro's power scarcity with self-built substation capacity is the regional moat claim.
productsAndServices.soldThrough: Wholesale and colocation contracts under the ODATA brand.
targetSegments: Hyperscalers localizing cloud/AI capacity in Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Chile
productsAndServices.roadmap: Colombia BG02/BG03 initial phases targeted end-2026; QR03 build-out toward full 300 MW / five buildings continues.

recentDevelopments.headline: Aligned publicly commits to Texas Gov. Abbott's responsible data-center development standards — grid infrastructure funded by the developer, zero-water operational cooling, community engagement — as the state audits all ERCOT interconnection-queue data centers
recentDevelopments.read: The waterless-cooling pitch converts directly into regulatory insurance: Aligned positions its closed-loop design as already compliant while the audit freezes less-prepared competitors' Texas pipelines.

recentDevelopments.headline: $1.183B asset-backed securitization completed (Series 2026-1) — upsized ~30% from a $905M target; first ABS since 2023; collateralized by four campuses with 14 enterprise customers and >90% of annualized adjusted base rent from investment-grade counterparties
recentDevelopments.read: One week after the $40B close, the debt market re-opened at scale for the new owners — and the collateral disclosure is the closest thing to tenant-quality data Aligned ever publishes.

recentDevelopments.headline: AIP, MGX, and BlackRock's GIP close the ~$40B acquisition of 100% of Aligned's equity from Macquarie Asset Management-managed funds — the largest data-center M&A deal on record; $5B of additional growth capital committed; Schaap and management retained, HQ stays in Dallas; platform stated at 51 campuses / 6.4 GW operational and planned
recentDevelopments.read: The single defining event of the dossier: the AI-capital complex (Microsoft, NVIDIA, xAI among AIP's backers) now owns the landlord — vertical alignment of demand and capacity that no competitor sale has matched at this scale.

recentDevelopments.headline: Project Caprock breaks ground — 540 MW, 313-acre, ~1.65M sq ft six-building campus in Hale County (Abernathy), Northwest Texas on Aligned-funded Xcel Energy infrastructure; first facility LBB-01 targeted Q1 2027
recentDevelopments.read: Aligned's first true gigascale greenfield — sited where power and land are unconstrained rather than where data-center clusters already exist, with the utility build funded by the developer to control the timeline.

recentDevelopments.headline: $2.58B development ('Devco') revolving credit facility closed — 3-year term plus two 1-year extensions, collateralized by six US development assets, funded by insurance companies, pension funds, and institutional lenders
recentDevelopments.read: A purpose-built construction-finance layer between the corporate SLL and the ABS takeouts — the capital stack industrializing in step with the buildout.

recentDevelopments.headline: Calibrant Energy (Macquarie-backed) to deploy a 31 MW / 62 MWh battery energy storage system at Aligned's Pacific Northwest campus, operational 2026 — described as the first US battery system purpose-built to accelerate data-center interconnection
recentDevelopments.read: Storage as a queue-jumping instrument: converting the campus into a flexible grid load buys interconnection speed in power-constrained markets — a template Aligned says it will repeat.

recentDevelopments.headline: AIP, MGX, and BlackRock's GIP agree to acquire all equity in Aligned at ~$40B enterprise value — AIP's first investment; anchor investors Kuwait Investment Authority and Temasek; strategic partners Microsoft, NVIDIA, xAI, Cisco, GE Vernova, NextEra; Macquarie exits a position built from 85 MW (April 2018) to 5+ GW / 50 campuses
recentDevelopments.read: The record sale price (derived ~$8M per MW of announced operational-and-planned capacity, unverifiable without financials) is best read as the market's price for a proven multi-GW delivery machine plus its cooling IP — and as Macquarie's textbook infrastructure exit.

recentDevelopments.headline: Blackstone Credit & Insurance (BXCI) expands its financing partnership past $1B in total commitments — upsizing the senior secured facility that began at $600M (March 2024) for the West Jordan, UT campus
recentDevelopments.read: Insurance-account private credit keeps scaling with the platform — a second validation channel independent of the ABS market.

recentDevelopments.headline: ODATA launches QR04 (24 MW IT, first 12 MW operational) near San Miguel de Allende — completing a four-facility interconnected Querétaro network and consolidating the claim to largest data-center provider in Mexico
recentDevelopments.read: The Mexico thesis compounding: each addition rides the self-built substation capacity that solved the region's power scarcity — the hardest-to-replicate asset in LatAm.

recentDevelopments.headline: Third Ohio campus announced: a 197-acre mega-scale AI campus at Conesville Industrial Park, Coshocton County (former AEP coal-plant site), multi-billion-dollar phased build with the first data center targeted mid-2026 — anchored by a customer Aligned did not name
recentDevelopments.read: Brownfield-to-AI conversion at a retired coal plant is the power-first playbook in miniature: existing grid infrastructure, no incumbent data-center competition, and an unnamed anchor signed before the announcement.

recentDevelopments.headline: Advanced Cooling Lab opens in Phoenix — a live test environment for Delta³, DeltaFlow, and hybrid configurations against the densest current GPUs and emerging AI accelerators, doubling as an operations training center
recentDevelopments.read: An in-house thermal-validation lab is what separates a cooling-IP company from a cooling-marketing company; it also de-risks the air-to-liquid transition pitch for tenant engineering teams.

recentDevelopments.headline: Lambda named as tenant at DFW-04 (Plano, TX) — a liquid-cooled facility supporting NVIDIA Blackwell and Blackwell Ultra GPUs, under construction at announcement
recentDevelopments.read: A rare named tenant: the neocloud segment wants Aligned's liquid-ready halls on delivery schedules the hyperscale giants monopolize elsewhere — and Lambda is willing to be public about it.

recentDevelopments.headline: ODATA energizes 200 MW of substation/transmission capacity at Querétaro QR03 with partner Ammper — the campus (300 MW IT, five buildings, ~3M sq ft, $3.3B investment) is Mexico's largest; first 72 MW building ready Q2 2025
recentDevelopments.read: Solving energy scarcity with self-built transmission converted Querétaro from a constrained market into ODATA's moat — capacity competitors cannot lease their way into.

recentDevelopments.headline: $12B+ capital raise completed — $5B+ new primary equity led by Macquarie Asset Management with unnamed global digital-infrastructure investors, plus $7B+ of new debt commitments, to accelerate 5+ GW of planned capacity
recentDevelopments.read: In hindsight, the pre-sale dress rehearsal: the raise proved third-party appetite at scale nine months before Macquarie monetized the whole platform at $40B.

strategyRead: (High confidence) We assess the AIP acquisition converts Aligned from a fund-owned developer into the buildout vehicle of the demand side itself. Basis: the consortium that closed the ~$40B purchase on 21 July 2026 — AIP's first-ever investment — counts Microsoft, NVIDIA, xAI and Cisco among its members, committed $5B of growth capital at closing, and retained management; the landlord's owners now include its most probable tenants.

(High confidence) We assess proprietary cooling IP is Aligned's genuine differentiator, not marketing. Basis: Delta³'s source-capture arrays (~1% of IT load in fan power vs ~10% for CRAC/CRAH rows, 50+ patents), the DeltaFlow universal liquid platform (350kW/rack heat rejection, zero-downtime air-to-liquid conversion in live halls, 600+kW/rack hybrid), an in-house Advanced Cooling Lab (Jun 2025) and localized Delta Cube manufacturing in Brazil — a sustained build-not-buy pattern across a decade.

(Moderate confidence) We assess Aligned is pivoting from cluster infill to gigascale greenfield on the West Texas model. Basis: Project Caprock (540MW, Hale County, self-funded Xcel interconnection infrastructure, first service Q1 2027) is its first campus sited outside every existing cluster; the Calibrant BESS framed explicitly as an interconnection accelerator (31MW/62MWh, Oct 2025) and the August 2026 endorsement of Texas' data-center standards point the same direction.

(Moderate confidence) We assess capital cadence, not ownership, is the operating constant. Basis: the 30%-upsized $1.183B Series 2026-1 ABS priced one week after the AIP close; the platform ran a $12B+ raise (Jan 2025), a $2.58B development revolver (Mar 2026) and a BXCI facility upsized past $1B (Aug 2025) — financing machinery that did not pause for the largest data-center M&A on record.

(Low confidence) We assess hyperscaler anchors stand behind the unnamed-tenant pattern. Basis: company practice names only neocloud tenants (Lambda at DFW-04) while ABS collateral discloses 14 customers with >90% investment-grade rent; the buyer consortium's composition is consistent with, but does not confirm, hyperscaler anchor tenancy. Collection gap: no anchor-tenant identities disclosed.

specs: Up to 50 kW per rack on air alone, without stranding capacity; ~75°F average room temperature
Fan power ~1% of IT load vs ~10% for typical CRAC/CRAH units (company figures); a single moving part per array
Captures heat at the source and handles high return-air delta-T — up to ~45°F vs the 3–7°F exchange of conventional air systems (trade/partner descriptions)
Closed-loop, waterless heat rejection; company claims up to 80% less energy and 85% less water than conventional cooling
25% cooling-capacity uplift in the 2020 generation; 50+ issued patents, 500+ patent claims across the portfolio
technicalSpecs.notes: Descended from founder-era Inertech conductive-cooling IP; manufactured in Brazil for the LatAm platform since 2024 (ODATA announcement).

technicalSpecs.product: DeltaFlow universal liquid cooling + hybrid halls
specs: 350 kW per rack of heat rejection; ~2x the cooling capacity of air-only, ~1000x more efficient at heat dissipation than air (company figures)
One technology-water/propylene-glycol spine feeds direct-to-chip cold plates, rack-mounted CDUs, rear-door heat exchangers, and immersion pod heat exchangers; ~65°F average supply temperature
Closed-loop waterless standard configuration — company cites tens of millions of gallons saved per data center annually
Hybrid Delta³ + DeltaFlow: 600+ kW/rack combined heat rejection; zero-downtime air-to-liquid transition in live data halls; no power-delivery or hall-temperature changes required
Launched January 2024 spanning 3 to 300+ kW/rack in a single platform (patent-pending)
technicalSpecs.notes: Validated in the Phoenix Advanced Cooling Lab (opened June 2025) against current-generation GPUs and emerging accelerators before field deployment.
